rows.expectedResultText: Dark green, fine granular, free flowing powder

tests.procedure: Under strong white light check each received sample container separately in a clean transparent watch glass or glass dish to detect foreign particles, colour and compliance with the visual specifications.

appearanceByProduct.45U21242: Dark green, fine granular, free flowing powder

tests.procedure: Make a slurry of the powder in equal quantities of isopropyl alcohol and methylene dichloride; pour it on a glass tile and dry. Expected: film formed.

Weigh an empty crucible previously ignited at 800 C (W1). Weigh about 1.0 g sample into the ignition plate (W2). Ignite in muffle at 800 +/- 50 C for 2 h; cool in desiccator; weigh plate with residue (W4). W3 = W4 - W1; total ash (wt) = W2 - W3; % total ash = total ash (wt) / W2 x 100. Note: W2 is defined as the sample weight but the step subtracts W3 from it; see openQuestions.

Aseptic technique under validated LAF. Weigh 10 g sample into a sterile container and make up to 100 mL with tryptone soya broth; process within 1 h. Pipette 1 mL of dilution into each of 4 plates: 2 SCDA (TAMC, 24-72 h at 30-35 C) and 2 SDA (TYMC, 5-7 days at 20-25 C). Total count (CFU/g) = (colonies plate 1 + colonies plate 2) / 2 x DF, DF = 10. Below detection: report 'less than 10'.

details.reference: USP 2024 <2021> Microbial enumeration tests; USP 2024 <2023> Microbiological Attributes of Non-sterile Nutritional and Dietary Supplement

tests.procedure: Same preparation as TAMC: SDA plates incubated 5-7 days at 20-25 C; total count as for TAMC (DF = 10).

From the dilution: incubate 24-48 h at 30-35 C; transfer 1 mL to 10 mL MacConkey broth, 42-44 C 24-48 h; subculture on MacConkey agar 30-35 C 18-24 h. Confirm: Gram stain (gram-negative short rods); EMB dark-centred colonies; TBX blue or green colonies at 42-44 C; identity by identification system (report if probability above 70 %).

details.reference: USP 2024 <2022>; USP 2024 <2023>; In-house Specification for Opadry Green

openQuestions.question: Two spec sheets cite the same STM (STM-RM-114) for two product codes, Opadry Green 20A21508 (sheet 1) and 45U21242 (sheet 2), with different appearance text. The STM lists both appearances. Both loaded as separate appearance rows, keyed by product in parameterName; confirm which product codes the local item 'Opadry green' covers.
